survey.notes: 84 of 531 known pages; saturation reached at page 54. Site-wide: icons 99%, inputs 99%, forms 98%, logo/tag wall 94%, card grid 88%, choice/disclosure/tabs 83%, breadcrumb and current-page marker 82%. One-offs: Lottie 2%, marquee 2%, carousel 2%, banded sections 1% (only /small-bets), large image 14%, animation 10%. Only 16 pages captured in depth (home, small-bets, discover and 13 category pages that are one template with a different header color). Marketplace screenshots are full of third-party seller artwork, which is content and not the design. Blog, help, pricing, features and about pages were surveyed but not captured in depth, so their layout is not evidenced.

character.summary: A flat, black-outlined, bubblegum-pink maker's marketplace: every control is a 1 px black rectangle with a 4 px corner that physically lifts off the page on hover, leaving a hard offset shadow behind it. Warm off-white paper, pure black ink and one hot pink carry the interface, while category pages flood their header with a single saturated color (teal, yellow, periwinkle, lime, red) and the home hero floats big flat pink 3D coins. The voice is plain and confident, set in one regular-weight geometric grotesk with slightly tight tracking; nothing is soft, blurred or gradient.

color.notes: Ink, paper and white make up about 90% of painted area; pink is under 1% of area yet on nearly every page (button style on 79 of 84). At most one pink action per viewport plus small pink tags. Saturated category colors flood only the page header band (267 px tall on /3d, 169 on /discover) and never appear on cards or body. Surfaces stack: paper page, white card with 1 px black border, nothing translucent. Dark: black ground, #242423 cards, #ddd text, pink replaces black as the primary button fill, borders become rgba(221,221,221,.35) hairlines except on active controls, hard shadows turn white at 25-35% (theme.json dark:shadow-[4px_4px_0_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.35)]).

motion.reducedMotion: The stylesheet contains prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference and reduce rules (styles.json mediaQueries); marquee and parallax are the animations affected. imagery.illustration: Flat vector with heavy black outline, hard color fills, no gradients or shading: huge pink 3D coin discs with an extruded rim, a UI mock with a pink character on teal, and tiny sticker pictograms (blue, red, teal, yellow, pink, each with an offset darker outline) in the tag wall. A mascot Lottie draws black strokes with trim paths over pink, yellow and orange fills (stroke widths 3-15, round/square/butt caps). Source art is proprietary and is not to be copied.

signatures.name: Hard-lift buttons (physical offset shadow)
signatures.what: Every actionable rectangle is a flat color block with a 1 px black border and 4 px corner. On hover it moves up-left by 4 px (8 px for the hero CTA) and a solid, blur-free 4 px black shadow appears where it was; on press it drops back flush. Dark mode uses white at 25-35% for the shadow. 150 ms, cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1).
signatures.frequency: CTA buttons and links on about 90% of pages (79 pink, 73 black, 74 outline); hover diff recorded on 12 pages.
signatures.recipe: 1) Element: inline-flex, border 1px solid ink, radius 4px, padding 12px 16px, no blur anywhere. 2) transition: transform, translate, box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1). 3) :hover { translate: -4px -4px; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 0 var(--ink) }. 4) :active { translate: 0 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 transparent }. 5) For a hero or lone CTA use a wrapper position:relative with a pseudo-element of the same size filled ink; hover moves the real button -8px -8px so it reads as a stacked plate. 6) Secondary fill-flip: transparent, white or black buttons swap to accent pink with ink text on hover. 7) Dark: shadow color rgba(255,255,255,.35). 8) Cards may borrow a 2px 2px version.
signatures.motion: hover: translate 0 -> -4px,-4px and shadow 0 -> 4px 4px, 150ms; press: back to 0 in the same time. Reduced motion: drop translate and shadow, keep color/border change.

signatures.name: Flat pink sticker illustration with black outline (3D coins, mascot, icon stickers)
signatures.what: Illustrations are flat vector shapes in brand pink #ff90e8, teal, yellow, periwinkle and red, each circumscribed by a heavy black outline, with a second extruded rim implying a 3D disc; no gradients, no soft shadows. Hero coins are 200-250 px wide, tilted 20-60 degrees, cropped by the viewport and drifting upward in parallax. Small versions are 25-32 px tag-wall stickers with an offset darker contour.
signatures.frequency: Home hero (5 coins), tag wall, about-page mascot Lottie, small-bets logo sticker; absent on 12 marketplace pages besides tiny icons. Hero-level on 2-3 pages but the most recognizable mark.
signatures.recipe: Inline SVG. 1) Base ellipse (rx > ry for a tilted disc) in accent pink, stroke ink 2-3px. 2) Duplicate the shape offset 12-16px along the tilt axis, fill pink, stroke ink, send behind; join the sides with two straight ink lines to form the rim. 3) One bold ink glyph or symbol centered on the top face, skewed with the disc. 4) Fills only from palette roles (pink, yellow, teal, periwinkle, red) and ink; never a gradient. 5) Stickers: 28px glyph, one role color, stroke ink 1.5px, and an offset duplicate in a darker tone. 6) Place at section edges, cropped by overflow, 3-6 per hero with different tilts. 7) Parallax: wrap the layer in an absolute container and animate translateY(0) to translateY(-50%) bound to scroll (animation-timeline: scroll() or a transform on scroll). 8) Mascot drawing: stroke-dasharray/dashoffset or a trim path draws the ink over 8s linear, then fills fade up.
signatures.motion: Parallax scroll: coin layer translateY 0 -> -50% across the hero scroll, linear; mascot: trim-path draw-on 8000 ms at 24 fps; marquee stickers slide with the tag rows, 60000 ms linear infinite. Reduced motion: static composition.

signatures.recipe: 1) Assign each domain, section or workspace one role color from a 5-color set. 2) Header: full-width band background var(--category), border-bottom 1px ink, padding 32px 64px, content width 1312px. 3) Inside: logo, a white 1px-outlined search input (48px tall), outline Log in, black primary button; below, pill nav links, 16px text, current = white fill with 1px ink border, 40px high. 4) Under the nav, the section title at 16-20px and subcategory chips as white pills. 5) The same color may reappear only as a tiny chip dot, never as card fills. 6) Keep the color constant between parent and children (/3d and /3d/3d-assets are both teal; structure.json p2, p13).
signatures.motion: static; color changes by navigation, no transition. Tab hover: border-color transparent -> ink instantly.

doNot: Do not add blurred or soft shadows, glass, gradients or translucent surfaces; the only depth is a hard-edged offset shadow
Do not use radii above 4px on buttons or inputs, or turn the primary action into a pill
Do not use pink as a large background field of the interface; it stays on CTAs, tags and illustration
Do not use thin or grey borders on primary controls; borders are 1px solid ink
Do not use bold headings; weight 400 with -0.4px tracking carries the voice
Do not scatter category colors onto cards; they live in the header band
Do not use bouncing or fading entrance animations; motion is 150 ms and mechanical
Do not copy the coin, mascot, wordmark or G mark
ipRisks: Gumroad wordmark and the G coin mark (custom logotype and 3D coin artwork): draw an original disc with an own glyph
The mascot character, Small Bets logo sticker and tag-wall sticker pictograms
ABC Favorit (Dinamo, proprietary): use DM Sans or Figtree (OFL)
The exact pink #ff90e8 as a brand identity: keep as a token only if paired with own artwork, or shift hue
Product names, seller artwork and copy such as the home headline
